senses.gloss: (f. (עָרַךְ) arranging, ranging; rolling (bread); use of the stem ערך.
units: Y. Yoma II, end, 40ᵃ נאמר כאן ע׳ וכ׳ the verb ʿarakh is used here (Lev. I, 7) &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:2:19">Y. Snh. X, 29ᵃ</cite> top <he>עֲרִיכָתוֹ</he> the forming of the show-bread.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:38">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>על לישתה ועל עֲרִיכָתָהּ וכ׳</he> for kneading it, for forming it and for baking it; a. fr.—Tanḥ. Bḥuck. 6 <he>עֲרִיכַת גיהנם</he> (prob. to be read: <cite ref="P01324"><he>עֲרוּכַת</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="P01324"><he>עֲרוּכָה</he></cite>) the pile of the fire of Gehenna (ref. to <he>ערוך</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 30:33">Is. XXX, 33</cite>).—
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 662:2">Yalk. Ps. 662</cite> <he>פת עריכה</he>, v. <cite ref="P01375"><he>עָרַךְ</he></cite>.
